The following events took place in '''4007 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jev Sunrider]] appeared to his grandson [[Andur Sunrider]] while the latter was working in a [[Garden/Legends|garden]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darada]].<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
*The [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] participate in the [[Quesaya Border Conflict]].<ref name="GaW" />
